## Highlights
### Improved
- Site Controls now tell certificate errors, mixed content and dangerous sites apart, and Find in Page shows how many matches a page has where the engine can count them.
### Fixed
- Permission changes made in Settings or Site Controls now reach open pages without reloading them. - Background tabs on iPhone keep the page's real title instead of its site name. - Importing bookmarks or a Crest archive into a new Space opens that Space on its first tab again. - In compact mode the sidebar opens and closes reliably on hover again. - Dragging a tab out of a window opens it in a new window again. - What's New on the sidebar's update card opens the full release notes again.
---
Experimental builds are signed and notarized snapshots from the selected branch (chromium-control-plane). They may be less reliable than development or stable releases.
